mapper.sql: status_id AS statusId, group_key AS groupKey, effect_id AS effectId, effect_kind AS effectKind, tick_formula_id AS tickFormulaId, damage_type AS damageType, can_crit AS canCrit, crit_chance_source AS critChanceSource, crit_chance AS critChance, crit_multiplier AS critMultiplier, affected_by_heal_modifier AS affectedByHealModifier, per_stack AS perStack, extend::text AS extendJson
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.status_periodic_hp_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY status_id, group_key, effect_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.status_periodic_hp_effects (game_id, status_id, group_key, effect_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, effect_kind, tick_formula_id, damage_type, can_crit, crit_chance_source, crit_chance, crit_multiplier, affected_by_heal_modifier, per_stack, extend, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{statusId}, #{groupKey}, #{effectId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{effectKind}, #{tickFormulaId}, #{damageType}, #{canCrit}, #{critChanceSource}, #{critChance}, #{critMultiplier}, #{affectedByHealModifier}, #{perStack}, COALESCE(CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, status_id, group_key, effect_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, effect_kind = EXCLUDED.effect_kind, tick_formula_id = EXCLUDED.tick_formula_id, damage_type = EXCLUDED.damage_type, can_crit = EXCLUDED.can_crit, crit_chance_source = EXCLUDED.crit_chance_source, crit_chance = EXCLUDED.crit_chance, crit_multiplier = EXCLUDED.crit_multiplier, affected_by_heal_modifier = EXCLUDED.affected_by_heal_modifier, per_stack = EXCLUDED.per_stack, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.status_periodic_hp_effects_log (game_id, status_id, group_key, effect_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, effect_kind, tick_formula_id, damage_type, can_crit, crit_chance_source, crit_chance, crit_multiplier, affected_by_heal_modifier, per_stack, extend) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{statusId}, #{groupKey}, #{effectId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{effectKind}, #{tickFormulaId}, #{damageType}, #{canCrit}, #{critChanceSource}, #{critChance}, #{critMultiplier}, #{affectedByHealModifier}, #{perStack}, COALESCE(CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, status_id, group_key, effect_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, effect_kind = EXCLUDED.effect_kind, tick_formula_id = EXCLUDED.tick_formula_id, damage_type = EXCLUDED.damage_type, can_crit = EXCLUDED.can_crit, crit_chance_source = EXCLUDED.crit_chance_source, crit_chance = EXCLUDED.crit_chance, crit_multiplier = EXCLUDED.crit_multiplier, affected_by_heal_modifier = EXCLUDED.affected_by_heal_modifier, per_stack = EXCLUDED.per_stack, extend = EXCLUDED.extend
